projects.title: Four-bit absolute comparator
projects.description: Designed and optimized a four-bit absolute comparator, from Boolean logic to circuit-level performance. Verified functionality in MATLAB and explored the trade-off between energy consumption and delay.
details: Designed four-bit absolute comparator logic using truth tables and Karnaugh maps; verified functionality in MATLAB.
Evaluated energy-delay trade-offs by varying gate sizes and supply voltage along the critical path.
Reduced energy consumption by 48.13% with delay at 1.5 times the baseline, preserving logical functionality.
